title: Luminal, which provides an inference cloud and develops inference compiler software to test running AI models on different chips, raised a $25M Series A (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Luminal, which provides an inference cloud and develops inference compiler software to test running AI models on different chips, raised a $25M Series A — Luminal, a search compiler and inference cloud provider, raised a $25 million Series A led by Standard Capital, CEO Joe Fioti tells Axios Pro exclusively.
